pre_edit_plan: Map known observation failures to hostStatus DEGRADED and inconclusive/unavailable/stale evidence to UNKNOWN; return VERIFIED only when all host observations are VERIFIED.
Keep service identity, readiness, and manager ownership gates; preserve known service/ownership failures as DEGRADED and avoid a false VERIFIED result.
Add deterministic listener-present tests with missing and stale process identities and a full-evidence aggregate test.
Do not change gateway, UI, authentication, process identity checks, or manager operation behavior.

findings_closed.title: UNKNOWN host observations could yield hostStatus VERIFIED
findings_closed.implementation: Host status is DEGRADED if any observation is DEGRADED or FAILED; UNKNOWN if statuses contain unavailable, unknown, stale, missing, or unrecognized evidence; VERIFIED only if the set of observed statuses is exactly VERIFIED.

findings_closed.title: Listener-present readiness behavior lacked deterministic coverage
findings_closed.implementation: Temporary fixture tests force loopback listeners and prove a missing or stale process identity stays non-verified, readiness stays UNKNOWN, and overall status cannot be VERIFIED from listener evidence alone.

regression_tests.name: test_unknown_or_unavailable_host_observation_does_not_verify_host_status
regression_tests.proves: CPU UNKNOWN and memory UNAVAILABLE observations result in hostStatus UNKNOWN.

regression_tests.name: test_known_host_observation_failure_is_degraded_not_unknown
regression_tests.proves: A failed mocked GPU provider produces FAILED observation and DEGRADED host/overall status.

regression_tests.name: test_listener_without_process_identity_is_not_readiness_or_health
regression_tests.proves: With controlled listeners and missing process records, process identity is UNKNOWN, readiness is UNKNOWN, and overall status is not VERIFIED.

regression_tests.name: test_listener_with_stale_process_start_identity_is_not_verified
regression_tests.proves: A controlled listener plus a PID with mismatched recorded start ticks yields STALE identity, UNKNOWN readiness, and non-VERIFIED overall status.

regression_tests.name: test_verified_aggregate_requires_and_accepts_all_verified_evidence
regression_tests.proves: Explicitly verified host, service, readiness, and ownership evidence reaches VERIFIED; changing CPU evidence to UNKNOWN makes host and overall status UNKNOWN.

changed_files.details: Host status and top-level unknown-versus-known-failure aggregation.
Deterministic host status, failure distinction, listener, missing/stale identity, and verified aggregate regression tests; deterministic repair to existing unavailable-hardware test fixture.
Documented host and overall status semantics.

final_commands.result: Both JavaScript files passed syntax checking.

intermediate_failure.detail: A pre-existing unavailable-GPU test inherited the environment's process count, which independently exceeded the collector cap and made hostStatus DEGRADED. Process count and disk usage were then controlled in the temporary fixture; the final run passed all 17 tests.

compatibility_and_limitations: Gateway and frontend contracts did not change; frontend displays the collector's status directly.
Production service readiness still emits UNKNOWN for a listener and UNAVAILABLE without one; no production readiness probe returns VERIFIED.
The verified aggregate test supplies verified service-readiness evidence as a fixture to exercise the collector's aggregate success branch; this does not establish a live service probe.
No service operation or manager operation was invoked; no live database or persistent runtime state was accessed or changed.
No live integration verification was performed.
